name: China Electronics Corporation
zh: 中国电子信息产业集团有限公司

evidence.summary: SASTIND lists CEC among China’s defence-industry group companies (军工集团). CEC calls itself the pioneer of China’s military electronics industry under the Party, lists military electronics among its five business segments, and names strengthening the military as its first responsibility.

CEC describes itself as a key state-owned enterprise administered directly by the central government, with cyberspace and information technology as its core business; its headquarters are in Shenzhen.
